hack.root_cause: Precision/Rounding Error in Custom Liquidity Distribution Function (LDF)
hack.description: Bunni's custom Liquidity Distribution Function — its key innovation over standard Uniswap math — was gamed with precisely sized trades to produce rounding errors that let an attacker drain $8.4M from two pools while leaving behind 1,000+ self-incriminating transaction logs.
